thread:
Nina Rao: FYI: eng proposes breaking change for partner SDK v4 — drop legacy `batch` envelope, require `X-Redwood-Auth: v2` and stricter content validation. This impacts marketplace connectors, on-prem HW adapters, and SI integrations. Need a partner-facing migration playbook and canary partner list.
Priya Kapoor: Noted. GTM prefers a minimum 8-week notice and a staged marketplace rollout. Can we offer partner migration credits and an invite-only early access canary?
Marco Silva: Hardware partners have quarterly firmware windows. Ask: can we provide a shim or adapter plugin for our gateway to smooth the transition? Otherwise some partners will miss the window.
Ben Chu: We can ship a feature-flagged compatibility adapter for Dedicated/on-prem installs and an SDK flag `--compat-mode=shim|warn|strict`. Adapter supported for 6 weeks post-freeze. Will push header spec this week.
Dana Li: I'll draft the partner one-pager and a checklist: impact summary, timeline, tests, rollback steps, support contacts. Also scheduling partner office hours and two webinars (APAC / AMER+EMEA).
Samuel Ortiz: SIs want an automated test harness and sample app changes. Offer to run up to 3 integration runs for strategic SIs if they sign up for the canary. Also request a migration bounty for complex integrations.
marketplace-bot: Draft marketplace banner saved at /mkplace/drafts/sdk-v4-migration-banner.
Nina Rao: Proposed timeline: publish spec in 7 days, code freeze in 21 days, deprecation window 60 days after freeze. Compatibility adapter available at freeze for 45 days. Canary partners onboarded during the 21-day pre-freeze window.
Priya Kapoor: GTM asks: publish partner comms kit (email, FAQ, banner, webinar slides) at spec + 2 days. We will include a migration checklist and registration link for canary program. Suggested webinar dates: 2026-02-10 and 2026-02-12.
Marco Silva: Request for shim test: need a build artifact and a plain-English adapter migration example. We'll test shim against our gateway fleet and report firmware timing blockers.
Ben Chu: Quick example to include in the spec:
```
# old payload
{"batch": [{"input":"..."}], "model":"rwd-base"}
# new payload
{"requests": [{"input":"..."}], "model":"rwd-base"}
# required header
X-Redwood-Auth: v2
```
Also will add a detection endpoint that returns `X-Redwood-Deprecation: batch-v3` if legacy envelope observed.
Dana Li: Actions: 1) Ben -> header + adapter spec (ETA 7 days). 2) Nina -> canary partner list + migration credits proposal (ETA 5 days). 3) Priya -> GTM kit + webinar landing page (ETA 9 days). 4) Marco/Samuel -> validation and test plan for HW and SI (ETA 7 days).
Samuel Ortiz: Can we add telemetry to the shim to surface adoption rates and failing adapter call traces? That will help prioritize follow-ups.
Ben Chu: Yes, shim will emit anonymized adoption metrics and deprecation warnings. We'll gate telemetry on partner consent for on-prem.
marketplace-bot: Reminder set for 2026-02-01 15:00 UTC to confirm canary roster.
Nina Rao: Great. Let's keep blockers in this thread. Will coordinate invites once canary list and migration credits are finalized. :white_check_mark:
